steps.name: Real screenshot capture
steps.environmentNote: Headless VPS has no local Chromium binary installed; live browser capture requires host with Playwright Chromium.

steps.name: Image-bound review request creation
steps.detail: Enriched executionkit-native-visual-request/v1 with full surface/state/locale/direction/theme/viewport context, pre-computed geometryFindings, geometrySeverityCounts, presentationObservation, appliedTypefaces, designRefinementFramework, responseShape, and submitCommand.

steps.name: Actual Antigravity native vision execution
steps.detail: Without a configured host executor or signed native response, inspectVisualRun writes enriched request and returns REVIEW_REQUIRED with submitCommand; never fabricates PASS.

steps.name: Valid structured reviewer response
steps.detail: Validates nonce, runId, cellId, imageSha256, 21 required dimensions with >= 20-char observations, and image-bound findings via executionkit visual inspect --response.

steps.name: Independent reviewer identity
steps.detail: Enforces reviewerId === cfg.critic.reviewerId and reviewerId !== manifest.producerId (VISUAL_REVIEWER_SEPARATION_VIOLATION).

steps.name: Current source/image hash verification
steps.detail: Verifies SHA-256 of on-disk PNG and geometry JSON, PNG dimensions >= viewport, and HMAC-SHA256 seal.

steps.name: Finding creation and remediation
steps.detail: P0/P1 findings fail auditVisualRun and block closure until source remediation.

steps.name: Re-render and re-review
steps.detail: Verifies git ancestry (beforeSha -> afterSha), distinct rendered PNG pixel delta, geometry improvement, and resolved finding across 21 dimensions.

steps.name: Audit certification
steps.detail: Requires VALIDATED full-mode run plus live application nonce probe before sealing certification.json.

steps.name: Decision OS and Launch OS enforcement
steps.detail: Unresolved P0/P1, REVIEW_REQUIRED, or uncertified visual evidence compiles to deterministic DENY across quality_gate, release_approval, release_publish, and deploy.
